blurb: Balloons Over Letchworth offers hot air balloon passenger flights and tethered rides at Letchworth State Park. Flights provide aerial views of the park's natural features. They also host special events and educational programs involving balloons.
extraNote: Prices valid until December 31, 2026 · Weather dependent flights and tethered rides · Call recorded weather update line at 585-243-3178 ext 1 for flight status · Letchworth State Park, Upper Middle Falls launch site · May through October
